subject: Tracing retention cost modeling & sample invoice
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@acme-analytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tracing retention — follow up on billing model

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our engineering leadership liked the tracing UI, but procurement and finance want a clearer example of how observability add-on charges would show up on an invoice. Specifically:

- How is tracing storage billed? (daily ingest vs. retained bytes vs. indexed spans)
- Do you prorate retention if we change windows mid-month?
- Any credits or bundling discounts for longer commitments?

Can you send a sample line-item invoice and a couple of cost scenarios (50k spans/day, 200k spans/day) showing monthly cost at 30/90/365-day retention? Also copy our procurement alias (procurement@acme-analytics.com) so they can review legal/PO items.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — aiming to finalize numbers for next week's exec procurement meeting.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
CFO, Acme Analytics
procurement@acme-analytics.com


From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tracing retention — follow up on billing model

Tom —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached are two stubs: a sample invoice and an itemized cost model (cost-scenarios-acme.xlsx). High-level answers up front:

- Billing model: we charge tracing as a combination of ingest (per-span) + storage (per-GB-month for retained indexed traces). Indexing (for query/trace search) adds a modest per-span factor.
- Proration: retention changes are prorated daily for the billing period; if you increase retention mid-month we bill the delta days at the retained-GB rate.
- Discounts: we offer tiered discounts tied to committed spend and retention buckets; for 12-mo commitments we can layer an add-on discount and a one-time onboarding credit.

Attached: cost-scenarios-acme.xlsx (tabs: assumptions, 50k/day, 200k/day) and a sample-invoice-acme-ops.pdf (line items called out). Key assumption highlights are on the first tab. If you want, we can convert the scenarios into a single PO line with blended monthly rate for procurement.

Next steps: 1) tell us which retention profiles you want modeled (30/90/365?) 2) confirm whether you want indexing-for-search included in the baseline or as a toggled add-on 3) are you open to a 12-month commitment in exchange for a staging credit?

I'll follow up internally to get a formal offer and a one-page SOW for procurement.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: cost-scenarios-acme.xlsx (spreadsheet stub); sample-invoice-acme-ops.pdf (pdf stub)


From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acme pricing ask — options & negotiation levers

Marissa / Monica —

Looping you both in for the pricing/credit decision. Acme (CFO + procurement) wants concrete invoice examples and clear language around retention proration. They are higher-volume (likely 200k spans/day across dev+prod) if we include search indexing. Proposed levers: 

- Offer A: 12-month commit on add-ons (observability retention + tracing index) -> 15% off add-on list + one-time onboarding credit equivalent to one month of baseline add-on spend.
- Offer B: Month-to-month with tiered overage caps -> no upfront discount, but 2 months free on first quarter if they hit a usage floor.
- Offer C: Blended PO line (single blended add-on unit price) for procurement simplicity + scope for audit logs add-on as upsell.

Product question (Monica): can we formalize a 15% first-year add-on discount for committed retention buckets (30/90/365) and confirm proration logic for retention changes? Also, do we have a standard PO line format for blended add-on pricing?

Want to land Offer A if Product signs off. We can present a clean line-item SOW with the sample invoice and the HubSpot deal attached.

Thanks,
Karthik


From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@acme-analytics.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Tracing retention — follow up on billing model

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. I pulled a few realistic scenarios and attached a single-sheet revised-pricing-acme.xlsx with line-item examples you can paste into a PO. Summary: 

- 30-day retention (indexing included): $X/month for 50k spans/day, $3.8k/month for 200k spans/day.
- 90-day retention (indexing included): ~2.6x the 30-day cost (storage scaling + indexing factor).
- 365-day retention: dramatically higher — we recommend using TTL-based warm storage for long tails and keeping the indexed window to 90 days unless you need full-text trace search across a year.

Offer we can present to Acme: 15% off observability add-on list for a 12-month commitment (applies to retention and advanced dashboards), plus a one-time implementation credit equal to one month of projected add-on spend. We will also waive first-quarter overage fees if you commit to the 12-month term.

Attached: revised-pricing-acme.xlsx (single-sheet with 30/90/365 scenarios and PO-ready line items).

If that looks good, Karthik — can you schedule a 20-min call with Tom & procurement to walk the numbers and confirm the PO format? I can join briefly to answer questions on credits and retention mechanics.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachments: revised-pricing-acme.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
